      public GTNetProtocolDescriptor.Builder transientSend()
      The sender keeps no local message row for this code, so its envelope names none. Declared by the ping and by the payload exchanges, which are built by a service and answered in the same HTTP response; without it the receiver refuses the envelope for carrying no sender-local id.
